title: Typed Optional-State Layout Identity & Fail-Closed Runtime Contract

base.meaning: recognized base/default optional-state topology; not a universal assertion that optional state can never exist in all future profiles

typed_layout_contract.identity_semantics: optional_state_layout_id is template capability/topology metadata; it does not imply that every column using a typed template currently allocates that optional state
typed_layout_contract.unknown_identity_semantics: fail closed; arbitrary positive IDs are not inferred as thermal or snow

runtime_admission_contract.soil_temperature_active: requires exact restricted-soil-temperature layout ID 390501 and rejects simultaneous snow-active configuration
runtime_admission_contract.snow_active: requires exact snow layout ID 60605 when soil temperature is inactive
runtime_admission_contract.inactive_optional_physics: recognized typed layout capability may remain present without allocating optional state

restart_contract.base_layout: requires neither snow nor soil-temperature state allocated
restart_contract.snow_layout: rejects thermal state; snow state may be allocated or absent for inactive columns
restart_contract.restricted_soil_temperature_layout: rejects snow state; thermal state may be absent for inactive columns; allocated thermal state must be ready and node-count compatible

nonclaims: No new science, physics, solver method, optional-state family, or scientific tolerance is qualified by F-MR41.

F-MR41 does not requalify snow-process physics or replay the full historical F-MR06 snow runtime against current canonical source; it pins the historical snow layout identity and qualifies current typed identity/restart semantics.
F-MR41 does not qualify a snow-plus-soil-temperature combined runtime profile; the combination remains rejected.
F-MR41 makes no new performance, scaling, or parallel-throughput claim.
F-MR41 performs no canonical promotion and does not reopen or modify immutable RB1 release authority.

closeout_replay.purpose: replay the full F-MR41 gate on the evidence head while asserting that the three production blobs remain identical to the qualified candidate source authority

downstream_rule: Any canonical admission must recheck the then-current integration/f-ci-canonical head and recompose/requalify if canonical has moved. Do not infer canonical authority from this closed work branch.
